image_description: A black and white photograph of a narrow, dimly lit staircase viewed from the bottom looking up. The stairs are flanked by brick walls on both sides. A handrail runs along both walls, supported by brackets attached directly to the brickwork. At the top of the visible flight, there is a landing with a horizontal railing section featuring vertical balusters, illuminated by a skylight above.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handrails clearly follow the diagonal incline of the staircase on both the left and right sides.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While there is a continuous handrail, the main sections running up the stairs are supported by wall-mounted brackets, not balusters. Balusters are only present in the horizontal section at the top landing.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handrails appear as smooth, continuous strips (likely metal given the reflection) running parallel to the steps.
